summary: Kevin Buckelew works in Buddhist studies and sinology. He studied at Sarah Lawrence College and Columbia University (Ph.D. 2018 under Bernard Faure, Chün-fang Yü, and Zhaohua Yang). In 2018, he became Assistant Professor at Northwestern University.

Kevin Vogelaar specializes in Buddhist studies and history and archaeology. He earned degrees from SUNY New Paltz, Fordham University, and Tufts University. He held positions at Fordham, Tufts University (2019–2020), and the Armenian Museum of America (2020).
Kexin Zheng works in indology and religious studies. As of 2026, Zheng is a PhD candidate at Leiden University, studying under doctoral supervisor Peter C. Bisschop.

Khakyab Dorje (1871–1922) was an active figure in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under teachers including Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, and Khenchen Tashi Özer, and later taught numerous students, including Kalu Rinpoche.
Kham Sum Zilnön Gyepa Dorjé studied under Shenphen Nangwa and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso. He taught Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.

Khammai Dhammasami is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed his DPhil at the University of Oxford (ca. 2000–2004). He founded Oxford Buddha Vihara and Shan State Buddhist University, and held posts at Oxford, Oxford Centre for Buddhist Studies, and ITBMU.
Khanderao Deshpande, an indology scholar, completed his doctoral studies under Moriz Winternitz. In 1969, he was attested as Joint Director at Osmania University.
Khangsar Tenpe Wangchuk (1938–2014) was a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under traditional teachers Jampal Gyepe Dorje and Lodro Gyatso.
Khen Gen Jampal Dorjé studied under Shenphen Nangwa and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso.

Khen Rinpoche Ngawang Jinpa specialized in Tibetology and Buddhist studies, studying at Drepung Loseling Monastery. He served as a professor at St. Joseph's College, Darjeeling (attested 1995), and taught students including Kevin A. Vose and Lobsang Tendzin.
Khenchen Ngawang Khyen Rab Gyatso studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Trulshik Rinpoche.

Khenchen Palden Sherab Rinpoche (1938–2010) was a scholar of Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy. He studied at Gochen and Riwoche monasteries under teachers including Dudjom Rinpoche, and chaired the Nyingma section at CIHTS (~1967–1984).
Khenchen Tashi Özer studied under Patrul Rinpoche, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, and Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye. He taught students including Khakyab Dorje and Shechen Gyaltsab.

Khenchen Thrangu Rinpoche (1933–2023) worked in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy. He studied under Khenpo Gangshar and the 16th Karmapa, founded Thrangu Monastery, and served as abbot at Rumtek Monastery, Karma Shri Nalanda Institute, and Gampo Abbey.
Khenchen Tsewang Rigdzin studied under Shenphen Nangwa, Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Shechen Gyaltsab, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso.

Khenpo Appey Rinpoche (1927–2010) was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar. He studied at Dzongsar Monastery under Drakgyab Lodrö, served as Director of Sakya College (1972–1985), and held a post at the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology.

Khenpo Dazer was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied under Botrul Dongak Tenpai Nyima. He served as a teacher at both the Ngagyur Nyingma Institute and Śrī Siṃha Shedra, and taught Chökyi Nyima Rinpoche.

Khenpo Gangshar (1925–1980) was a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Shechen Monastery under Khyentse Ozer, Shechen Kongtrul, and Karsé Kongtrul, later serving as Senior-Lehrer there and founding dean at Surmang Monastery (~1957–1959).

Khenpo Jigme Phuntsok (1933–2004) was a Tibetology and Buddhist studies figure. He studied under Botrul Dongak Tenpai Nyima (~1951–1958) and Ba Tur Khenpo Tubten Chö Pel (~1947–1951), among others, and taught many students including Khenpo Sodargye.

Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche (1924–2019) worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Thrangu Monastery and under Khenpo Gangshar and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje. He taught at Rumtek Monastery (1967) and was abbot of Karma Triyana Dharmachakra (1978).
